title: Tariq Mehmood Malik- VS -The State etc.
text:
Form No: HCJD/C-121 
ORDER SHEET. 
IN THE ISLAMABAD HIGH COURT, ISLAMABAD. 
JUDICIAL DEPARTMENT. 
Criminal Misc. No.2247 of 2025  
Tariq Mahmood Malik 
 
VS 
 
The State 
 
S. No. of 
order/ 
proceedings 
Date of  
order/ 
Proceedings 
Order with signature of Judge and that of parties 
or counsel where necessary.  
01.01.2026
Mr. Ishtiaq Ahmed, Advocate for the petitioner 
alongwith the petitioner.  
 
 
 
Through the instant petition, the petitioner 
Tariq Mahmood Malik s/o Malik Muhammad Anwar, 
seeks protective bail in a case F.I.R No. 98/2023, 
dated 25.09.2023, offence under Section 420, 489-F 
P.P.C., registered with Police Station Chilas, District 
Diamer, Gilgit Baltistan. 
 
2. 
It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioner that on account of imminent threat of 
arrest, the petitioner is not able to approach the 
Court of first instance and, therefore, he may be 
granted protective bail.  
 
 
3. 
The accused namely Tariq Mahmood Malik is 
granted ad-interim transitory bail for seven (07) 
days. Accused is directed to approach the Court of 
competent jurisdiction on or before 08.01.2026. 
Instant bail granting order shall cease to exist and 
expire automatically after the Court hours of 
referred date i.e. 08.01.2026. 
 
4. 
The instant petition stands disposed of in the 
above terms.   
 
 
 
          (MUHAMMAD ASIF)      
                      JUDGE 
                        
Ahmed Sheikh 
Copy dasti
